crossRefs.note: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, “Your servants will do as my lord commands.
Go near, and hear all that Yahweh our God shall say, and tell us all that Yahweh our God tells you; and we will hear…
Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who…
Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,
Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme;

parallels.note: I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, “Your eyes have seen all that Yahweh your God has done to these two kings. So…

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: They answered Joshua, saying, “All that you have commanded us we will do, and wherever you send us we will go.
translations.bsb: So they answered Joshua, “Everything you have commanded us we will do, and everywhere you send us we will go.
translations.kjv: And they answered Joshua, saying, All that thou commandest us we will do, and whithersoever thou sendest us, we will go.
translations.asv: And they answered Joshua, saying, All that thou hast commanded us we will do, and whithersoever thou sendest us we will go.
